title: CFA / ACCA Foundations
description: Professional exam pack. Numeric problems are verified exactly by the mathcheck service; concept and ethics questions are graded on rubric. Timing metadata feeds mock-exam mode.

problems.prompt: You invest 1,000 at 8% simple interest. How much interest have you earned after 3 years?
1,000 invested at 10%, compounded annually. What is the future value after 2 years?
What is the present value of 1,210 due in 2 years, discounted at 10% a year?
Explain to a client, in plain words, why money today is worth more than the same money next year.

criteria: mentions the chance to earn a return

problems.prompt: Current assets are 150,000 and current liabilities are 60,000. What is the current ratio?
A company's revenue grew this year but its cash balance fell. Name two places in the financial statements you would look first, and say why.

criteria: mentions receivables or working capital movement
links the reason to accrual versus cash timing
answer is structured, not a list of everything

problems.prompt: A client asks you to leave one poor-performing year out of a performance report because "it misrepresents the fund's quality." What do you do, and why?

criteria: cites the duty of fair and accurate presentation
offers a compliant alternative, like showing the full record with context

problems.prompt: Timed. Fixed costs are 40,000. Price is 25 per unit, variable cost 15 per unit. How many units to break even?
